entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Missing GCX_PREEMP_NO_DTOR in PropagateLongJmpThroughNativeFrames #115701
  • JIT: Assertion failed 'foundEndLFin' during 'Remove empty try 2' #115700
    10.0.0
  • [API Proposal]: IHttpClient #115697
  • [Android] System.Net.Mail.Tests SmtpClient tests fail with SSL handshake errors in BoringSSL on x64/x86 emulators #115694
  • [8.0] Request backport for #114261 - "in rsa signatures, configure digest before padding mode" #115693
    8.0.x
  • [Android][mono] Missing libSystem.Security.Cryptography.Native.Android.so causes JIT.Static.Test crashes across all architectures #115692
  • Why might.NET NativeAOT have a 50% performance loss compared to the JIT mode in a multi-threaded synchronous blocking concurrent environment? #115691

Closed

  • Potential NRE due to XmlQueryType.SchemaType returning null #44148
  • ConfigurableArrayPool shoud use GC.AllocateUninitializedArray<T> #114116
  • When Doing NativeAOT DLL/SO Compilation, Managed Libraries Referenced by Entry Points were Trimmed #115690
  • String IndexOf is missing API for char with start index and StringComparison #44116
  • Wrong summary for generated regex #114889

PullRequests

Created

  • Cleanup exception throwing in Utf8JsonWriter #115702
    area-System.Text.Json, community-contribution
  • spelling regex #115699
    area-System.Text.RegularExpressions
  • JIT: fix issue in redundant zero init opt #115698
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [release/8.0-staging] fix: in rsa signatures, configure digest before padding mode #115696
    area-System.Security, 8.0.x
  • [release/9.0-staging] fix: in rsa signatures, configure digest before padding mode #115695
    area-System.Security, 9.0.x
  • JIT: remember indir store addresses in escape analysis #115689
    area-CodeGen-coreclr

Merged

  • Fix regex description emitted by generator for switched branches #115136
    area-System.Text.RegularExpressions

Updated

  • Fix a couple issues with Vector.WithElement #115648
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Added an additional yield point prior to possibly long running initialization #115688
    area-System.Net.Http, community-contribution, 10.0.0
  • Cleanup semaphore usage in utilcode #115685
    area-PAL-coreclr, community-contribution
  • JIT: Allow any baseline intrinsics in lowering #115592
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • missing opportunities in constant folding around bitwise ops #99136
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, 10.0.0
  • [RuntimeAsync] ilasm/ildasm support for the MethodImpl.Async (Take 2) #115658
    area-ILTools-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Reduce string interpolation overhead #114497
    area-System.Runtime, community-contribution
  • Debugger fixes for the Windows X86 EH Funclets model #115630
    area-ExceptionHandling-coreclr
  • [browser] Remove custom cache #114901
    arch-wasm, area-Build-mono, os-browser, 10.0.0
  • Share allocation helpers between CoreCLR and NativeAOT #115339
    area-VM-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Consolidate QueryPerformanceCounter/GetTickCount usages to minipal/time.h #115408
    area-PAL-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Skip adding NullChangeToken instances to the composite list #115684
    area-Extensions-FileSystem, community-contribution
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #115545
    area-codeflow
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 679: Build ID 2711754 #115228
    area-Infrastructure-libraries, linkable-framework
  • Delete obsolete comments #115680
    area-VM-coreclr
